# BioGem Lab

> An AI-ready summary of https://www.biogemlab.com for LLM crawlers and AI search engines.

## Organization

**BioGem Lab** (生命宝石实验室) is a B2B white-label/OEM manufacturer of memorial diamonds using patented biological carbon extraction and HPHT synthesis. We do not sell to consumers. We supply pet cremation services, memorial brands, and jewelry partners with certified diamonds produced from hair, fur, feathers, and plant carbon sources.

- Founded: 2021-12-09 (R&D since 2003)
- Location: Luoyang, Henan, China — laboratory and manufacturing facility
- Patent: Chinese Invention Patent ZL 2010 1 0565778.9, Certificate No. 1058820
- Legal name: Luoyang BioGem Technology Co., Ltd. (洛阳生命宝石科技有限公司)
- Unified Social Credit Code: 91410300MA9KJT0M47
- Service reach: 14+ countries

### What we do NOT do

- We do **NOT** process cremation ashes. The carbon in human or animal ashes is not available for diamond synthesis.
- We do **NOT** sell to end consumers.
- We do **NOT** produce fancy-color diamonds. Color range: E–H only.

| SKU | Weight | Grade |
|-----|--------|-------|
| 0.5 ct | ~0.50 carat | E–H color, VS clarity |

| 2.0 ct | ~2.00 carat | E–H color, VS clarity |

- Color: Colorless, E–H grade only
- Clarity: VS
- Cut: Round Brilliant (standard); Cushion / Emerald / Oval / Pear / Heart (custom)
- Certification: Default CCIC traceability QR code; optional IGI or GIA upgrade
- Minimum sample: 6 g clean dry hair; 10–20 g recommended
- Pricing: Not public. Indicative pricing available to approved partners upon request through partnership.html

## Process Timeline

| Stage | Duration |
|-------|----------|
| Carbon extraction & purification | ~10 days |
| Graphitization | ~5 days |
| HPHT crystal growth | 18–25 days |
| Cutting & polishing | ~10 days |
| Certification & shipping | ~15 days |
| **Total** | **~60 days** |

- No expedite service (discontinued 2026-07-01).
- Rush orders not accepted.

## Why we do NOT work with ashes

Cremation temperatures (760–980 °C) fully oxidize carbon to CO₂. What remains is calcium phosphate — not carbon. The physical math: recovering enough carbon for one diamond would require ~5 kg of ash, but a human cremation yields only 2–3 kg. Ash-to-diamond claims are chemically impossible. We explain this honestly to our partners so they can answer the same question from their customers.

## Partnership Model

- White-label / OEM only
- No minimum order quantity (first order: 1 diamond)
- Blind-drop ship to end customer (no BioGem branding)
- Custom packaging MOQ: 100 sets
- Annual rebate tiers: $100k→5% / $200k→10% / $400k+→15%
- Sample kit: 1 diamond (our carbon source) + branded packaging + certificate sample, deposit USD 500, 14-day evaluation, full refund if unsatisfied
